visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a close-up of a hand holding an iPhone in a light blue case over a wooden table. A gold ring sits nearby. On screen, a user scrolls through the Threads app. A large flame and smoke explosion effect overlay covers the screen briefly as bright yellow variety text appears. (2) A woman with short dark hair and bangs, wearing a beige sleeveless top and a matching shrug, sits on a lime green sofa holding a silver MacBook. She looks directly at the camera with a friendly expression. Behind her is a white metal shelf with a volleyball and various books. (3) The scene shifts to a detailed screen recording of the Threads mobile app. A finger with dark nail polish navigates through the settings menu: clicking the profile icon, then the hamburger menu, selecting 'Content Preferences,' and finally 'Hidden Words.' The user types Chinese characters into a search bar. (4) The screen recording continues on the Instagram app. Similar navigation occurs as the user enters the 'Hidden Words' section to add keyword filters. The interface is dark mode. (5) Back on the sofa, the woman continues speaking while gesturing with her hands. She smiles and nods. Suddenly, the camera zooms in rapidly on her face as a blue water-vortex effect swirl appears, mimicking an anime special move. (6) In the final scene, the woman is kneeling on a grey mat in a different room with white brick-patterned wallpaper. She is bound by brown ropes around her arms and torso, and wears a black face mask with a large yellow 'X' taped over it. She looks towards the camera with wide eyes.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Variety]: 滑個 Threads 跟 IG... 都會暴雷鬼滅 真的很XX欸!. (2) [Subtitle]: 欸 你要不要設個 隱藏字詞 這樣就可以避掉 鬼滅貼文了. (3) [Subtitle]: 怎麼弄? Threads 的話 你就先點自己的頭像 再點右上角 兩條槓槓 點內容偏好設定 再點隱藏字詞 下面+號 新增篩選條件 你上面先幫這個條件命名 然後按下面新增字詞 你就可以打個 鬼滅 炭治郎 猗窩座 之類的 打完後就按儲存 這樣相關貼文 就不會出現在你的頁面囉!. (4) [Subtitle]: IG 的話 一樣點到自己的頁面 然後點右上角 三條槓槓 往下滑找到 內容偏好設定 點特定字詞和短語 這邊就可以新增 想隱藏的關鍵字 打完之後按新增 跟完成就 OK 囉!. (5) [Subtitle]: 吼 居然還有這個功能太好了 暴雷真的不行耶! 對啊 暴雷真的 影響觀影體驗耶 對啊 欸 你知道我跟你說 猗窩座... [Variety]: 啊啊啊啊啊啊. (6) [Subtitle]: 水の呼吸 壱ノ型!. [Logo]: @aottergirls.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with high-tempo, bright electronic pop background music. A loud, stylized fire explosion SFX accompanies the visual blast. The female host speaks with a high-energy, frustrated tone about spoilers. (2) As the scene transitions to the sofa, the female host's voice becomes friendly and helpful, speaking at a fast conversational pace. The BGM continues steadily in the background. (3) During the screen recording, the host provides a step-by-step narration. Digital 'click' and 'pop' UI SFX are heard as menu items are selected. Her articulation is clear and professional. (4) A male voice briefly joins the conversation off-screen, sounding surprised or inquisitive. The female host responds with an enthusiastic explanation. (5) Suddenly, a loud 'whoosh' transition SFX occurs, followed by an aggressive, shouted anime-style line: '水の呼吸 壱ノ型!'. The background music swells slightly in intensity. (6) The final seconds feature a muffled, struggling sound from the host, now bound, contrasted with a comedic silence from the background music as it fades out. A final digital ping SFX marks the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To provide a practical tech tutorial on how to use keyword filtering on Threads and Instagram to avoid 'Demon Slayer' spoilers, using a humorous anime-themed skit to increase engagement.
